name: order_gram_stain
description: Orders a Gram stain of a clinical specimen (wound, sputum, CSF, body fluid, etc.). Provides rapid preliminary identification of bacteria as Gram-positive or Gram-negative, and their morphology (cocci, rods, diplococci) to guide empiric antibiotic therapy.

specimen_source.description: Source/type of specimen (e.g., wound swab, sputum, CSF, blood, pleural fluid, joint fluid)

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering Gram stain

when_to_use: Rapid identification of bacterial pathogen before culture results
Specimen quality assessment (sputum: >25 PMNs, <10 squamous per LPF)
Joint fluid evaluation for septic arthritis

examples.query: Order Gram stain on the wound
